item: RULINGS_INDEX catches up: R174 to R191 recorded (the index stopped at R173)
summary: Eighteen rulings that lived only in the coordinator's memory files and chat relays are now in the index: the launcher deferred writer (R174), evidence-file trims (R175), several servers on one data folder (R176), the outlet key (R177), the collector governor (R178, R180, R181), the feedparser driver field (R179), the pause and its lift (R182), class F leases (R183), the qualification dry run (R184) and the five autonomous-mode answers (R185 to R189), #1456 (R190) and the CSRF-guard and create-database 422 pair (R191). Each row names where it is enforced; rows whose PR is open at the time of writing say so. R182's text is the coordinator's relay; the others are from the team ruling files.
